causalTrace.fact: Before dispatch, the unchanged authority guard requires the actual task to equal its own executionBasis.rawInputValue, with native graph/function/implementation/contract/effect/workspace/actor identity. This is not a B-added equality assumption.

Both shipped native author and assessment GraphFunctions contain one leaf and no sequential edge. A different progressed value under the same native basis cannot lawfully reach its effect owner; the pre-existing guard refuses.

Parent prepare leaves produce actual NativeTask, then declared workflow.C creates a child graph/basis whose input is that exact admitted parent output. Native own entry may differ from the parent/root entry without substituting either.

General current/progressed input still resolves from the admitted traversal cursor/producer route; graph-entry input and current input remain separate. Native assembly compares actual input/digest against that owner-derived input.

Retained fold authenticates parent route, child entry input, foldback, terminal, child Result/J and closure. It returns completed.result from the child, not the parent workflow Result. This rejects the hypothesized parent-envelope/native-task confusion.

The new task helper resolves the own basis and applies task-dependent native validation. It is an internal projection of an already admitted Result, not a standalone arbitrary-event admission API. Source projection additionally authenticates exact Result body/digest, invocation/workspace, native fibre, transport evidence, J and closure. Currentness caller iterates actual indexed native Results; default fold supplies the retained-input owner child Result.

Prospective shape/identity is separate from task-dependent semantics. Outcome admission still supplies actual CCall input; MatchesTask checks its inputDigest, after scope and changed paths, exact report/assessment schema and assessor independence. Actual actor/transport/prompt/input identity and worker_executes lane remain joined.
